JavaScript and TypeScript exports not followed: exports maps and subpaths, `export *` chains, CommonJS `module.exports`, declaration-only types, members added at run time
Example code that is the reader's own: placeholders, elided sketches, the reader's helpers and classes, relative imports, files the guide asks to create
Heading ids from the docs site's own slugger (MkDocs toc and attr_list `{ #id }`, VitePress, Mintlify, TanStack, gradio, hf doc-builder, pmndrs/docs)
Anchors and pages a docs generator creates (mkdocstrings, [[autodoc]], FAQ compilers, offline bundles, Storybook static files)
Links the docs site routes: page URLs with directory URLs, flat or prefix-free routes, redirects, example routes, extensionless pages
Snippets included into another page (`--8<--`, `{!file!}`): links resolve from the page that includes them
Markdown read wrong: footnotes as link definitions, `<...>` destinations cut at `)`, Vue bindings, unused or illustrative link definitions
Docstring layouts read as parameter names: `type (name)`, misplaced section headers, continuation lines, quoted sample docstrings
CLI flags judged against the wrong parser: a subcommand's or a forwarded client's own options
